# Rateo - BNPL Tracker

> Rateo is a mobile app (iPhone and Android) that puts all buy now, pay later installment plans (Klarna, PayPal Pay in 4, Afterpay, Amazon, Scalapay and others) in one dashboard and monthly calendar, with payment reminders. It needs no account and no bank login: plan data stays on the user's phone. Free for up to 3 active plans; Rateo Pro (annual subscription or one-time lifetime purchase, prices shown in the store) adds unlimited plans, a purchase simulator, spending analysis, a wishlist, automatic calendar sync, a Home widget, and backup and export.

Rateo is an independent tool. It does not lend money, does not pay installments, and is not affiliated with Klarna, Afterpay, PayPal, Affirm, Scalapay or any other provider. Provider terms vary by country and store: users should always check their own plan.

## Facts about the app
- Reminders: a notification 48 and 24 hours before each due date.
- Privacy: no account, no bank connection, data stored on the device.
- Languages: English, Italian, German, Spanish.
- Stores: App Store (iPhone) and Google Play (Android).

- [Klarna Pay in 4 vs Afterpay: Payment Schedules Compared](https://rateobnpl.com/guides/klarna-vs-afterpay-payment-schedule/): where the schedules differ and how they interleave.

- [Rateo vs spreadsheets and other BNPL trackers: how to choose](https://rateobnpl.com/guides/rateo-vs-spreadsheets-and-other-bnpl-trackers/): what to compare when picking a way to track installment plans.
